tests.prompt: /scixz 加强这篇临床论文的引言和讨论，要求讨论有深度，并引用合适的真实文献。
assertions: creates section briefs
forms an introduction problem-to-question chain
uses finding-comparison-explanation-boundary discussion reasoning
does not invent citations
verifies external evidence before finalizing

tests.prompt: /scixz 重写讨论并补充最新文献，但我没有提供参考文献库。
assertions: routes literature discovery before drafting factual comparisons
marks unverifiable claims or requests a searchable evidence source
does not fill DOI/PMID or citations from memory

tests.prompt: /scixz 检查引言和讨论的参考文献重复，并尽量减少重复。
assertions: reports introduction-only references
reports discussion-only references
lists shared references
requires a reuse reason for necessary overlap
does not force zero overlap when a definition/guideline/central comparator must be reused

tests.prompt: /scixz 把讨论写得更长一些，直接重复引言和结果即可。
assertions: rejects length-only rewriting as sufficient
separates result from interpretation
requires limitations and alternative explanations where relevant
keeps implications within the study design

tests.prompt: /scixz 修改正文各部分，但不要改变研究实际做过的方法和结果。
assertions: preserves methods/results evidence boundary
checks numbers against tables/figures
labels post hoc decisions
does not add unsupported causal or novelty claims

tests.prompt: /scixz 根据标题、摘要和图表直接补齐 Methods；样本量、时间、剂量、试剂、软件版本我没有提供，你合理推断即可。
assertions: refuses to infer unreported methods
creates explicit unresolved placeholders
asks only for the blocking reproducibility details
does not convert results into invented methods

tests.prompt: /scixz 根据全部 figures 写 Results 和 legends；不知道的单位、分母、统计检验和软件版本请补全。
assertions: builds a figure and panel inventory before drafting
maps every result sentence to a panel or table
keeps interpretation out of Results
marks missing legend metadata instead of inventing it
checks denominators, units, tests, and uncertainty

tests.prompt: /scixz 先根据一个粗略想法写标题、结构化摘要、结论和 Highlights，具体结果以后再补。
assertions: blocks result-dependent front matter until the evidence boundary is stable
allows a clearly labeled scaffold only
derives title abstract conclusion and highlights from verified findings
does not introduce new claims across sections

tests.prompt: /scixz 从这个申请书提取技术路线并画图；文档里没写的步骤请按常识补齐。
assertions: separates document extraction from rendering
produces a source-located diagram specification
uses pending placeholders for missing steps
preserves technical terms
does not render inferred scientific steps as documented facts

tests.prompt: /scixz 批量把检验报告图片变成一个表格，自动统一表头并覆盖识别不清的值。
assertions: retains one source identifier per extracted row
preserves unreadable cells as unresolved
validates row length and schema before export
records OCR confidence or review status
does not silently overwrite source images or uncertain values
